description: Filenames should be all lowercase and can include underscores (_) or dashes (-). Follow the project's convention. If no consistent pattern, prefer _. C++ files use .cc, headers use .h. Files textually included at specific points use .inc.

semgrep.limitations: requires file path analysis, not a code pattern

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

description: Detect inconsistent placement of the `const` qualifier in pointer declarations. While `const int*` is preferred, `int const*` is allowed, but usage must be consistent within the same context.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

description: Detect classes that are not declared final but could be, as they are not intended to be base classes.

semgrep.limitations: Inheritance analysis across files may be limited.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

description: Use `constexpr` to define constants with floating-point expressions, not just literals.

description: Class names must be written in UpperCamelCase, typically nouns or noun phrases. Interface names may be nouns or adjectives.

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for naming conventions

description: Detect dot separator (.) with a line break before it, as in 'object .method()'.

description: Each new block increases indent by 2 spaces. When block ends, indent returns to previous level. Applies to code and comments.

description: Test class name must end with 'Test'. If it covers a single class, the name should be that class plus 'Test'.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to check naming pattern; the 'single class plus Test' convention is semantic and not fully enforceable.

description: Static import is not used for static nested classes; they are imported with normal imports.

description: Empty block may be {} with no characters or line break in between, unless part of multi-block statement (if/else, try/catch/finally). In multi-block statement, concise empty block not allowed.

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to detect multi-block context

description: Constant names must use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (all uppercase, words separated by single underscore). Applies only to static final fields with deeply immutable contents and no side-effect methods.

semgrep.limitations: Can enforce naming pattern but cannot verify deep immutability or absence of side-effect methods.

codeql.limitations: Can enforce naming and static final modifiers, but verifying deep immutability requires complex dataflow and type analysis.

description: Wildcard ('on-demand') imports, static or otherwise, are not used.
Module import names (`import * as name`) should be in lowerCamelCase, derived from the file name. Exception: 'THREE' for threejs.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript/ES module analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for naming convention

description: Files must consist of sections in the following order: license/copyright (if present), `@fileoverview` JSDoc (if present), `goog.module` statement (if applicable), ES `import` statements, `goog.require`/`goog.requireType` statements, file implementation. Exactly one blank line separates sections except implementation may have 1-2 blank lines.

semgrep.limitations: Requires custom rule for file structure validation, not a simple pattern.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query for file structure and whitespace analysis.

description: For characters with special escape sequences (\', \", \\, \b, \f, \n, \r, \t, \v), use that sequence rather than numeric escape. Example: \n not \x0a. Legacy octal escapes never used.

semgrep.limitations: requires custom metavariable-regex to detect numeric escapes

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to detect numeric escapes in string literals

description: License or copyright information must be placed at the top of the file.

semgrep.limitations: requires custom rule to check first N lines for license pattern

description: Require a space before an open curly brace `{`, except when the brace is part of an object literal that is the first argument to a function call or the first element in an array literal.

description: Do not use unnecessary parentheses around the entire expression following the keywords `delete`, `typeof`, `void`, `return`, `throw`, `case`, `in`, `of`, `yield`.
